1) How to get a same‑day plumber in Fort Worth (fastest options)
Use any of these (all cover 76102 and do same‑day in most cases):
- Google Maps / Apple Maps: search “emergency plumber near me” or “plumber Fort Worth 76102”, sort by rating (4.5+), and pick one that shows “Open now” and “Offers emergency services.”
- Platforms:
  - Roto-Rooter Fort Worth
  - Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Fort Worth
  - Benjamin Franklin Plumbing (Fort Worth)
  - Any local company with 4.5+ stars, 100+ reviews, and “24/7” or “Same-day service” in the description

When you call or request online, you can use this script:

“Hi, my name is Jordan Reeves at 1234 Main Street, Fort Worth, TX 76102. I have a leaking kitchen sink with water pooling under the cabinet. I’ve had to put a bowl and towels down. I’m available any time today as soon as you can come. My phone number is (828) 555-6741 and email is jordan.reeves@example.com. Can you send someone today, and what’s your service call fee and estimated arrival time?”

If you’d like, tell me which company you’re leaning toward and I’ll tailor the script for their online form specifically.

2) What to do right now about the leak (to avoid damage)
Since water is pooling, treat this as urgent:

a) Turn off water to the sink if at all possible  
- Look inside the cabinet under the sink.  
- You should see two small shutoff valves (one on the hot line, one on the cold).  
- Turn both clockwise until they stop (hand‑tight is fine).  
- Test the faucet: if the water no longer runs, you’ve successfully shut it off.

b) If you can’t find or turn those valves  
- Turn off the main water to the house if the leak is more than a slow drip.  
- The main shutoff is usually:
  - In a box in the ground near the street (by the water meter), or  
  - On an outside wall where the water line enters the house.  
- Turn the main valve clockwise until it stops.

c) Protect the cabinet and floor  
- Keep the bowl under the leak, empty it as it fills.  
- Put down extra towels or a pan/tray to catch splashes.  
- If the bottom of the cabinet is soaked, prop the door open and, if safe, point a fan at it to start drying.

d) Electrical safety  
- If water is anywhere near an outlet, garbage disposal wiring, or dishwasher connection, avoid using those appliances and keep that area dry as best as you can until a pro looks at it.

If you tell me:
- Whether you can shut off the under‑sink valves, and  
- Whether you prefer a big brand (Roto‑Rooter/Mr. Rooter/Benjamin Franklin) or a highly rated local shop,

I can:
- Recommend what to prioritize calling first, and  
- Write a very short, copy‑paste message you can use in any “Request service” form so you don’t have to think about wording while dealing with the leak.</action>
